description: Appium configuration schema for the Xenon plugin.

platform.description: Which mobile platform(s) Xenon should discover and orchestrate.

androidDeviceType.title: DeviceTypeToInclude
androidDeviceType.description: Which Android device kinds to include: physical devices, emulators, or both.

simulators.description: Allow-list of iOS simulators (by name + sdk) to expose. Empty array means expose all discoverable simulators.

iosDeviceType.title: DeviceTypeToInclude1
iosDeviceType.description: Which iOS device kinds to include: physical devices, simulators, or both.

hub.description: URL of the Xenon hub this instance should register with as a node (e.g. http://hub.example:4723). Omit to run as a standalone hub.

remoteMachineProxyIP.description: Public host/URL that clients should use to reach this node when running behind a reverse proxy or NAT.

adbRemote.description: List of remote ADB hosts in host:port form (e.g. '192.168.1.50:5037') to discover Android devices on other machines.

skipChromeDownload.description: Skip the automatic ChromeDriver download performed by uiautomator2. Leave true unless you specifically need Xenon to manage Chrome binaries.

maxSessions.description: Maximum number of Appium sessions this node will run concurrently. Additional requests queue until a slot frees.

cloud.description: Cloud configuration object. See CloudConfig interface for details.

derivedDataPath.title: IDerivedDataPath
derivedDataPath.description: Map of derived data paths for iOS simulators/devices.

emulators.description: Allow-list of Android emulator AVDs to expose. Empty array means expose all discoverable emulators.

proxy.description: Proxy configuration object. See AxiosProxy interface for details.

deviceAvailabilityTimeoutMs.description: How long (ms) a session request waits for a free device before failing.

deviceAvailabilityQueryIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) the session queue polls for a free device while waiting.

sendNodeDevicesToHubIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) a node pushes its current device list to the hub. Only used when `hub` is set.

checkStaleDevicesIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) the hub prunes devices from nodes that have stopped heartbeating.

checkBlockedDevicesIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to re-evaluate manually-blocked devices and the session reconciler that frees orphaned busy devices.

newCommandTimeoutSec.description: Default Appium newCommandTimeout (seconds) applied when a client does not send one. Also drives the reconciler that releases devices idle past this threshold.

bindHostOrIp.description: Host/IP the Xenon REST and WebSocket server binds to. Set to 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces.

enableDashboard.description: Serve the React dashboard at /xenon/ and the Socket.io event stream.

bootedSimulators.description: Only discover iOS simulators that are already booted. Recommended on machines with many installed simulators — avoids allocating WDA/MJPEG ports for shutdown sims (the WDA pool is 8100-8199, 100 ports).

bootedEmulators.description: Only discover Android emulators that are already booted.

removeDevicesFromDatabaseBeforeRunningTh.description: Wipe the persisted Device table at startup so discovery begins from a clean slate. Useful after hardware changes.

healthCheckIntervalMs.description: Default interval (ms) between background device health checks. Overridden when `healthCheckSchedule` is set. Default 5 minutes — frequent enough to keep battery/thermal badges fresh without hammering devices.

healthCheckSchedule.description: Cron expression for the device health-check job (e.g. '0 * * * *' for hourly). When set, takes precedence over `healthCheckIntervalMs`.

databaseProvider.description: Database backend. Defaults to sqlite (file under ~/.cache/xenon). Use postgresql for multi-node hub deployments.

databaseUrl.description: Prisma-style database URL. For sqlite: `file:/path/to/xenon.db`. For postgres: `postgresql://user:pass@host/db`. Falls back to the DATABASE_URL env var.

aiProvider.description: AI provider for the LLM healing tier and visual analysis. Also controlled by XENON_AI_PROVIDER.

aiModel.description: Override the default model for the selected `aiProvider` (e.g. 'gemini-1.5-pro', 'gpt-4o', 'claude-sonnet-4-6'). Falls back to XENON_AI_MODEL.

aiBaseUrl.description: Custom base URL for the AI provider (e.g. a local Ollama server or an OpenAI-compatible gateway). Falls back to XENON_AI_BASE_URL.

geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key. Prefer setting XENON_GEMINI_API_KEY (or GEMINI_API_KEY) via environment instead of committing it to a config file.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key. Prefer setting XENON_OPENAI_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY) via environment.

anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key. Prefer setting XENON_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) via environment.

enableSelfHealing.description: Enable the 5-tier self-healing pipeline (Native → Fuzzy XML → OCR → Visual AI → LLM) for failed findElement calls. Can also be toggled at runtime from the dashboard.

buildCleanupDays.description: Builds/sessions older than this many days are purged by the cleanup job.

buildCleanupMaxCount.description: Maximum number of builds to retain. Oldest-first eviction beyond this cap regardless of `buildCleanupDays`.

buildCleanupSchedule.description: Cron expression for the retention job. Default '0 0 * * *' runs at midnight.

deleteBuildAssets.description: When true, the cleanup job also deletes session video recordings and screenshots from disk (not just DB rows).

sessionHeartbeatIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) each active session writes a heartbeat. The orphan sweeper uses ~3× this interval to detect abandoned sessions.

enableJsonLogging.description: Emit structured JSON log lines instead of human-readable text. Recommended for shipping logs to a log aggregator.

tlsRejectUnauthorized.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates for internal outgoing requests. Default is true. Set to false only for dev/test.

authDisabled.description: Disable API key authentication for all /xenon/api/* endpoints. Use only in local dev environments.

nodeSecret.description: Shared secret for hub-node channel authentication. Nodes must send this value in X-Xenon-Node-Secret header.

interceptor.description: Network request interception configuration (capture + mock + modify). See InterceptorConfig interface for details. Android-only in v1.

title: IPluginArgs

CloudConfig.title: CloudConfig
CloudConfig.description: Cloud configuration object. Should be provided via config file.

cloudName.description: Name of the cloud provider (e.g. browserstack, saucelabs, pcloudy, lambdatest)

url.description: URL of the cloud provider hub

apiKey.description: API Key for the cloud provider

apiUrl.description: API URL for the cloud provider

enabled.description: Enable the network interceptor. Sessions still need to opt in via any of: xenon:options.interceptor.enabled=true, xe:interceptor.enabled=true, appium:interceptor.enabled=true, a bare interceptor.enabled=true cap, or the flat interceptorEnabled cap.

bufferSize.description: Maximum number of captured requests to retain in-memory per session before evicting oldest.

captureBodies.description: Whether to capture request/response bodies. Disable for privacy or to reduce memory usage.
